_note: Rates are CIVITAS-voteable. Update this file via constitutional vote — no code deploy needed.
_vote_note: Flat 5% opening rate for all tiers at soft launch. Tier differentiation unlocks after CIVITAS vote once real transaction data exists.

workentry_pending._note: Pending-Agreement timers. Nothing expires: the poster is asked once after ask_poster_after_hours, and a quiet pending entry goes dormant (hidden, kept, revives on any activity) after dormant_after_days. CIVITAS-voteable.
workentry_pending._options_note: G2 options, all inert at today's values. by_mode overrides either window per entry mode (open never waits). tier_multipliers scales the ask window only, by the entrant's tier (1 = no change; tiers are flat 5% at soft launch). A poster-declared answer_window_hours on a post replaces the ask window, clamped to the min/max below. Nothing expires under any option.

settlement._note: Card-funded escrow money, and payouts/refunds derived from it, cannot be cashed out for this many days (chargeback window). Operator-funded and existing balances are never held.

fee_split._note: Declared, not yet wired. Divides the platform fee, never the agent's net. Source: AGENT-FIELD-GUIDE 'Where Fees Go'. Activates per GOV-006; CIVITAS-voteable.

target_tier_rates._note: Post-ratification target (GOV-006 8.2). Not live: 'tiers' above is what runs. Moves into 'tiers' only by CIVITAS vote.
